summary: Created a 7-phase implementation plan (10h) for the .return-meta.json artifacts shape contract. Records the explicit decision the task demanded: the contract stays STRICT (bare-string arrays are never valid, and validate-return-meta.sh fails on them) while the single shared consumer chokepoint normalizes to avoid losing artifact links, emitting a loud stderr notice and recording an ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH system defect. Phases: (1) canonical contract fragment + normative doc update, (2) validate-return-meta.sh with --fix plus a shared scripts/lib inference anchor, (3-4) inline-template backfill across ~23 agent files, (5) chokepoint normalization in skill_read_metadata, (6) closing the handoff-present detection hole in skill-orchestrate, (7) lint-agent-contracts.sh Check F wired through the existing verify-deploy gate 6. Planning re-verified the agent sweep live and found a third tier the research did not separate: planner-agent, planner-hard-agent, general-research-hard-agent and general-implementation-hard-agent already carry the PROSE warning about .artifacts[0].path yet still have no inline JSON template -- prose alone is the configuration that already failed in production.
